newsitem.title: USA: Stage Stores raises IPO to 11 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Stage Stores raises IPO to 11 mln shrs.

text.p: Stage Stores Inc said on Thursday it plans to increase its initial public offering to 11 million shares from 10 million shares.
The additional one million shares are being offered by certain existing shareholders, Stage Stores said.
Proceeds from the sale of shares of common stock by the company will be used to repurchase debt and remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, Stage Stores said.
Stage Stores, the parent of a family apparel stores operator, said CS First Boston, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securites Corp, Bear Stearns & Co and PaineWebber Inc are managing the offering.
The company and certain stockholders of the company are expected to grant the underwriters an over-allotment option covering additional shares of common stock, Stage Stores said.
